cohort: 112 pregnant women indicated for primary or repeat Cesarean section at term, with 60 undergoing FAUCS and 52 undergoing MLC
finding: Implementation of the FAUCS technique was safe and successful, resulting in improved maternal condition after Cesarean section, including lower pain scores, greater autonomy during recovery, and shorter hospital stays.
mod_finding: French ambulatory cesarean (FAUCS) was successfully performed in all cases, and women in the FAUCS group experienced shorter time to standing, time to full meal, and effective time to hospital discharge compared to the Misgav Ladach cesarean (MLC) group.
